item.title: U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth visits Arkansas as part of Arsenal of Freedom tour
item.description: Secretary of the U.S. Department of War Pete Hegseth made a stop in Arkansas today to thank over 1,500 L3Harris workers as a part of his “Arsenal of Freedom” tour.

item.title: Pine Bluff opens new park dedicated to Delta music and culture
item.description: Friday afternoon, city officials cut the ribbon on the new Delta Rhythm & Bayous Blues & Wellness Plaza. Located on Bobby Rush Way in downtown Pine Bluff, it's the latest addition to the city's Delta Rhythm and Bayous Cultural District.

item.title: AST Blog: A Change Is Coming and It Could Bring Storms
item.description: As for severe weather, the overall signal in Arkansas looks low at this point. There is some support for stronger storms to our west across the southern Plains, and if timing lines up just right, a few stronger storms could sneak into parts of the state.

item.title: North Little Rock investigating series of house fires they say were set intentionally
item.description: North Little Rock fire investigators say a troubling pattern of intentionally set fires has plagued the Rose City neighborhood for months — putting lives at risk and leaving lasting damage in its wake.

item.title: Razorbacks in the NFL Combine and Arkansas Baseball Recap | Paige's Point
item.description: It is a busy time of year for Arkansas, with former Razorbacks making headlines at the NFL Combine and the Diamond Hogs' season picking up.

item.title: Central Arkansans react after state police perform TVI during child’s medical emergency
item.description: Arkansas State Police on Friday said they agree with a prosecutor’s decision to drop charges against a driver who was stopped after a pursuit in downtown Little Rock, later learning the driver was rushing a child to the hospital during a medical emergency.

item.title: Little Rock Marathon road closures begin Feb. 26
item.description: The Little Rock Marathon will cause road closures in downtown Little Rock beginning Feb. 26, with the entire course expected to be open for traffic by 2 p.m. on Sunday, March 1.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Arkansas State Police responds after trooper hits car carrying child having medical emergency
item.description: Arkansas State Police has released a statement about a traffic stop incident that involved a child dealing with a medical emergency.
